pages.text: Bring a Gaia Spirit Fragment and initiate yourself. Mahou Tsukai is the T4 magic system: body enhancement magic that ties closely into the class system.

$(bold)Role in the pack:$() Mahou Tsukai's spells are the endgame magic path for the Archmage and the Battlemage. Its primary systems are enhancement magic (buffing yourself and others) and blade techniques (melee empowerment).$(br2)$(bold)Initiation:$() You need a Gaia Spirit Fragment (dropped by Botania's Gaia Guardian) to initiate. It is the bridge between T3 and T4 magic.
$(bold)Class synergy:$() The Archmage's Arcane Mastery stacks with Mahou Tsukai's magic power system. A T4 Archmage invested in Mahou Tsukai has some of the highest raw damage output in the pack.

$(bold)Craft the Mahou Tsukai Guidebook$() (recipe in JEI) for the full reference: magic circle construction, spell research and the Mahou stat system.$(br2)$(bold)Next: kill the Gaia Guardian$() for your initiation fragment ($(l:icraft:bosses/t4_bosses)Tier 4 Bosses$(/l)).
